headline.title: We searched "chiropractor Kitsilano Vancouver". Your booking page came third, but your own website appeared nowhere in 18 results.
headline.detail: Patients who clicked saw a booking page and an announcement, not your team or how your practitioners work together. Myodetox, a multi-city chain, appeared twice above you.

summary: Broadway AT Yew has 227 reviews at 4.8 and patients who have come for years because your practitioners work together on one plan. But a few blocks away, clinics with 358 and 551 reviews stay open later, one is open seven days, and in our search only your booking page appeared.

you.notes: Chiro, physio, RMT, acupuncture; to 5:30pm; closed Sundays

competitors.name: Etio Health
competitors.notes: Same block of W Broadway; chiro + physio

search.result: Medimap pages for Myodetox and Qi Integrated Health came first, then your Jane booking page. The rest were a BIA article, clinic finders, Myodetox's booking page and job postings. Your own website (vancouverbackpain.com) did not appear.
search.meaning: Google sends people to your booking page, but they never see the team approach that keeps your patients for years.

visibility: In our search for a chiropractor in Kitsilano, your booking page appeared third, but your own website did not. Nearby clinics with longer hours and more reviews compete for the same searches.
lead: 227 reviews and patients who have come for years.
Chiro, physio, massage and acupuncture working together on one plan.
Trusted through pregnancy, and praised for putting nervous patients at ease.
lose: You close at 5:30pm; clinics nearby stay open until 7 or 8pm, and one is open on Sundays.
Two clinics within a few blocks have 358 and 551 reviews.
Your team approach is invisible on a booking page.

gaps.title: After-work patients go elsewhere
gaps.detail: Many people can only come after 5:30pm. When they search, they find clinics that are open, unless they can book your next slot online in seconds.

gaps.title: Your team approach doesn't show
gaps.detail: 'Practitioners who work together' is why patients stay for years, but new patients can't see it before they book.

gaps.title: Pregnancy patients are a natural niche
gaps.detail: Expecting mothers praise you, but there's no page for them to find when they search.

actions.title: Explain your team approach on your own site
actions.why: It's your clearest difference from single-discipline clinics nearby.

actions.title: Create a page for pregnancy care
actions.why: Chiro, acupuncture and massage through every trimester is a search people make.

actions.title: Reply to reviews and ask regulars for new ones
actions.why: Doable today: your long-time patients are your best advocates.

plan.title: Your refreshed website with booking built in
plan.detail: Your team and approach explained, with one-tap booking.

plan.title: Automatic review requests
plan.detail: A friendly message after each visit.

plan.title: Pregnancy and recall programmes
plan.detail: Timed messages for expecting mothers and maintenance visits.

plan.title: Your first monthly report
plan.detail: Bookings and how you compare with West Broadway clinics.

scenario: A nurse finishing a shift at 6pm searches "chiropractor Kitsilano" for her aching back. Your booking page shows nothing until tomorrow, while a clinic a few blocks away is open until 8pm. She books there tonight, and it becomes her clinic. (Illustration.)
nochange: Your loyal patients stay, but new ones keep choosing the clinics that are open later and look bigger online. Over time, the strip's growth passes you by.
